newsitem.title: USA: First Union enters partnership with Schwab.
newsitem.headline: First Union enters partnership with Schwab.

text.p: First Union Corp entered a partnership with Charles Schwab Corp to offer investment advice on OneSource mutual fund program, becoming the first bank on the East Coast to do so.
First Union, the sixth-largest U.S. bank holding company, will operate through its registered broker-dealer, First Union Brokerage Services Inc.
Schwab's OneSource program offers more than 600 no-load mutual funds from 70 well-known fund families, including Janus, Twentieth Century, Scudder and Strong.
"We found that our customers want help and advice with no-load funds and OneSource gives us a premier product to offer," said Donald McMullen, of First Union's Capital Management Group.

Complementing First Union's current investment options, OneSource allows the company to offer investors a broader array of mutual funds with one consolidated brokerage account, and the benefit of advice on no-load mutual fund investing.
OneSource will be available through First Union Brokerage Services in the second quarter of 1997.
First Union has assets of $134 billion.
